strings.name: Jack Dongarra
strings.summary: Dongarra studies numerical linear algebra and high-performance computing. He contributed to LINPACK, LAPACK, BLAS and other open software and standards, and co-founded TOP500. His university and national-laboratory work adapted algorithms to parallel computing and evolving hardware. His 2021 Turing Award was announced in 2022; these achievements reflect sustained collaboration.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Developed high-performance numerical algorithms and software libraries, advancing scientific computing, supercomputer benchmarking and parallel-computing applications.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 18 July 1950 in Chicago, United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: BS, Chicago State(1972); MS, Illinois Tech(1973); PhD, New Mexico(1980).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Open numerical software
strings.highlights.h1.text: Contributed to LINPACK, LAPACK and BLAS algorithms, libraries and standards for scientific computing.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Supercomputer benchmarking
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-established TOP500, encouraging comparable supercomputer performance measurements.
strings.timeline.t1.title: 2021 Turing Award
strings.timeline.t1.text: ACM announced the award in 2022 for numerical algorithms and software libraries.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Co-founded TOP500
strings.timeline.t2.text: Established the global supercomputer performance list with collaborators.
strings.timeline.t3.title: LAPACK
strings.timeline.t3.text: Helped develop a linear-algebra library for modern computers.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Tennessee laboratory
strings.timeline.t4.text: Joined Tennessee and established the Innovative Computing Laboratory.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Doctorate
strings.timeline.t5.text: Completed a PhD in applied mathematics at New Mexico.
strings.timeline.t6.title: LINPACK
strings.timeline.t6.text: Contributed to the numerical package for linear equations and related problems.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Master’s degree
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed a computer-science master’s at Illinois Tech.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Mathematics bachelor’s
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed a mathematics bachelor’s at Chicago State.
